rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This Prometheus MCP server implementation by Freepik Company provides AI assistants with direct access to Prometheus monitoring data through three core tools: instant PromQL queries, range queries with time windows, and metric discovery. Built in Go with comprehensive authentication support including JWT validation, OAuth 2.0 flows, and basic/token auth, it can operate in both stdio and HTTP transport modes with configurable middleware for access logging and security. The implementation includes custom Prometheus client configuration with multi-tenant support via X-Scope-OrgId headers and integrates with enterprise identity providers through JWKS validation and CEL expression-based authorization rules, making it suitable for monitoring dashboards, alerting systems, and operational analytics workflows in production environments.
